setup.baseline: An enemy planet with a controlled defense count and no starbase.
setup.variable: Defense count, bomb type and invading colonists.

procedure: Record defense type/count and displayed stop percentages.
Bomb with one design and record population/installation losses.
Invade with a known colonist count and record losses.
Repeat with a starbase present and with different defense tech.

documented: Defenses protect against bombs and invasion, limited by population-operated capacity (documented-only).
Planetary defenses are 75% effective against enemy colonist drops (documented-only).
Bombing cannot begin while a starbase remains, and enemy population reports are +/-20% estimates (documented-only).
